description: Einsätze der Feuerwehr der Stadt Linz (Linz) is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.linz.gv.at. Number of fire brigade operations with the name of the operation, amount of damage to property and amount of rescued values. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Operations of the fire brigade of the City of Linz (Linz)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Technische Versorgung, OpenDocument, BSt, Stadtforschung, Infrastruktur. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
